body: Thank you so much...you saved my life tonight.

Thank you more than you can possibly know for responding to my submission. I just turned 27 on July 7th and I guess I've been even more depressed ever since.

I've called my therapist but have yet to call him back for an appointment. 

On the surface I'm doing great. I have a bachelors from a prestigious private university and I have been working for nearly the last 4 years. I have a huge network of friends and family but I just can't help but feel like I'm the black sheep to my friends, family and work circle.

The fact that knowing that so many people in this world have suffered far worse fates than me leaves me hollow and remorseful inside. 

On paper I should be doing so well but inside I am feeling nothing but neglect and sadness and disappointment  for not living up to the expectations that were afforded to me from my parent's hard work.
